Hi,
I just tried and could create a camera operation matrix. The date format in the csv is correct (2018-06-15). Check it in R after loading the csv file or in a text editor. Don't trust excel, it will automatically format the dates and show you something different than what is in the data.

Here's the code I ran:

test <- read.csv(".../sites_effort_covars.csv")   # set directory
cameraOperation(test, 
                setupCol = "Setup_date",
                retrievalCol = "Retrieval_date")

This means that cameraOperation works with the default dateFormat = "%Y-%m-%d".

A further question if you don´t mind. I will be receiving the date and time as separate columns for the real analysis (not from Digikam). Do I have to merge these two columns to the format "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S" in order to create the detection histories?

Yes, you can use paste() to combine the columns. You can also use different date/time formats, but you'll have to adjust argument recordDateTimeFormat if you do.

Let us know if it works.
Cheers,
Jürgen

Hi,
I could not reproduce the problem. It worked well for me. 

There was one initial issue which was easily fixed:

Error in cameraOperation(cameras, setupCol = "Setup_date", retrievalCol = "Retrieval_date",  : 
  MADWA06 : Problem ends after retrieval

There was a typo in the table (07.12.2018 instead of 12.07.2018). Fixed it and saved the table.

See the code below for a working example.

About the other questions:

I have a general question about the independence of records when one has an existing table of spp, not generated in a folder with pictures as with Digikam. A post from last year says that  “currently there is no function to filter for temporal independence in an existing record table. The filter is built into the recordTable function”. I would like to confirm if there has been any update on this?

See my reply to this other question in the group. It is currently not explicitly included in the package as a standalone function (it is included in recordTable and therefore invisible), but I provided a preliminary fix which should do the trick. A proper function to filter existing record tables will be provided in the next version of the package.

My project will involve lots of citizen science who ID camera traps photos. Most will be using the platform SnapShotsafari (zooniverse) and also some people using Digikam and sending through their output (as excel spreadsheet). Thus,  I will need to clean up the data using an independence criteria (for thousands of records!) . Would you please confirm if there is a way to set the independence between records for an existing output? (is the detection history above constructed having the day, 24h,as the independence criteria?)

See above. If you run occupancy analyses it doesn't matter much whether you use a record table with all records or just hourly (or whatever you consider independent) to build your detection history. One or a thousand records within an occasion will give a 1 in the detection history. Personally I don't really think of it as an independence criterion, because it is not consistent. Imagine you have 2 records just seconds apart, one before midnight, one after midnight. They will be "independent" if midnight separates two occasions.

All the best,
Jürgen
